svg.title: How each FDA adviser voted on the seven peptides, July 23-24, 2026
svg.desc: The 8 advisers newly appointed in 2026 cast 60 yes votes, 1 no and 1 abstention across 8 ballots. The other 11 members, holdovers, representatives and temporary members, cast 0 yes votes, 44 no and 8 abstentions (all 8 abstentions by the pharmacy-boards representative).

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every yes vote came from the 8 new advisers

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: FDA compounding advisory committee, July 23–24, 2026. FDA staff had recommended no on all seven.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: New members: 60 yes, 1 no. Everyone else: 0 yes, 44 no, 8 abstentions.
